entries.21c056a4315c6252: It is a business that operates home care services and paid nursing homes. entries.8eff31ede88efd01: It is a business centered on conducting funerals and memorial services. In addition to operating funeral halls and memorial halls, it provides embalming (body preservation), pet funerals, cemetery management and operates Buddhist altar shops. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, it opened five Family Halls supporting family funerals in Kanagawa and Tokyo prefectures, and started "Life Relief," a service supporting all aspects of end-of-life preparation. Revenue was ¥10,212 million, up 0.1% from the previous year. The number of funerals decreased due to fewer deaths in its main areas, while natural burial, household goods clearance and inheritance-related real estate businesses increased. Sun Life Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, mainly handles it, with SEC Co., Ltd. handling embalming and Pet Ceremony Wavy Co., Ltd. handling pet funerals.
